purpose: Source-only parity correction for the dedicated Phase171 raw-P no-Doppler GNSS-first plus Pose3/IMU lane.

source_contract.parameters_m: Street/Mix selects L_robust_prm=0.2; Highway selects 0.5; prm.L_kernel=huber(prm.L_robust_prm)
source_contract.fgo_gnss_imu_m: ordinary TDCP rows use noise_robust(prm.L_kernel, noise) with fixed source sigma input
source_contract.native_before: ordinary native TDCP default tdcp_huber_threshold_sigma=4.0; Phase182 used no source Type selector
source_contract.native_after: dedicated Phase184 selector resolves the exact Type mapping only for Phase171 staging and main graphs

implementation.staging_and_main: same config field is copied into the in-memory Phase165/167 staging config and retained by the Phase171 Pose3/IMU main config
implementation.legacy_preserved: Phase118 selector, normal-D paths, and selector-off Phase171 retain their existing threshold/default behavior

validation.synthetic_two_stage: FGOGtsamPhase171NoDopplerImuMainTest.SameRunC7DHandOffAdmitsEmptyDopplerAndGaugesAbsentClockSlots runs selector-off (4.0) and selector-on Street (0.2), including in-memory staging-to-main handoff
validation.actual_binary: build/tests/run_tests and build/apps/gnss_fgo_imu_no_base built with GTSAM

limitations: No native route rerun was authorized in this phase; Phase182 H structural/accuracy records remain unchanged.
This corrects only the source TDCP robust threshold. It does not assert that the Phase183 H accuracy scalar improves.
